item.text: CodeGraph’s telemetry stance is narrowly scoped: it collects only anonymous usage statistics such as which commands and MCP tools are used, which languages were indexed, coarse file-count and duration buckets for completed indexing, install/uninstall events, and daily aggregated usage totals by tool or command name. It explicitly guarantees that it does not collect source code, file paths, filenames, repo names or URLs, symbol names, search queries, IP addresses, geolocation, usernames, hostnames, emails, or environment variables, and telemetry can be fully disabled with `codegraph telemetry off`, `CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0`, or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` ([TELEMETRY.md](https://github.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/blob/main/TELEMETRY.md)).
